note.en: Authored offline construction of an interpretive Torre de Belém: about five thousand solid pieces from a recipe drop into place in construction order (coursed walls with real openings and arches, battlements, domed turrets, a loggia), with a day-to-dusk light and a deterministic 40-second film. Simplified proportions, not a survey. Silent by design; no runtime model calls.
note.zh-CN: 原创离线建造过程，示例为贝伦塔的示意模型：按配方生成的约五千个实体构件依施工顺序落位（带真实洞口和拱券的砌筑墙体、雉堞、圆顶角塔、凉廊），配有从白昼到黄昏的光线和可确定重放的 40 秒影片。比例经过简化，并非测绘。设计上无声音，运行时不调用模型。
